output.title: A Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP)
output.author: Jeffrey D. Case
output.organization: Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) SNMP Extensions Working Group
output.abstract: Defines the structure, identification, and management information base (MIB) for Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP), including protocol data units (PDUs), variable bindings, and trap mechanisms. Introduces enterprise-specific object identifiers and error reporting conventions.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: This memo outlines SNMP as a simple network management protocol using a manager-agent model. It defines PDU structures for requests, traps, and responses, along with MIB elements for monitoring network devices.

sections.title: Protocol Data Units (PDUs)
sections.content: Defines four PDUs: GetRequest (retrieve data), SetRequest (modify configurations), Trap (send asynchronous alerts), and Bootstrap (device initialization). Each includes request IDs, error statuses, variable bindings, and traps.

sections.title: Variable Bindings
sections.content: Variables are defined by name-objectname pairs with object syntax values. Used for storing device-specific metrics like interface statistics or system uptime.

sections.title: Trap Mechanism
sections.content: Asynchronous alerts sent from managed devices to the SNMP agent, containing error statuses and variable bindings. Supports enterprise-specific trap types for custom monitoring needs.

sections.title: Security Considerations
sections.content: Note: Security features like authentication or encryption are not addressed in this memo, focusing instead on basic management functionality.
